propositions: Signed gate verdicts record only a resolved provider:model string, so a consumer cannot distinguish a Bedrock-backed verdict from an Ollama-backed one.
Add a sibling provider_provenance object with provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities, keeping the existing model string field untouched for backward compatibility.
The provenance record is assembled from primitives in capabilities.py (a stdlib-only leaf) and threaded through runner.py, reusing the already-computed capability record rather than recomputing it.
endpoint_host must use urlparse(base_url).hostname to strip userinfo, never .netloc, so no credential material from base_url or api_key leaks into the persisted payload.
Story 2932 must land first so supports_temperature is present on the capabilities record before any verdict is signed, avoiding shape drift in an already-signed sub-object.
providers.py is at 299 LOC against an attested <300 cap and must not be modified; the provenance assembly belongs in capabilities.py instead.
